scope: Explicit opt-in same-import source observation for one bounded AC1018 TABLESTYLE extension XRECORD profile. This does not authorize DWG/DXF output or establish text/codepage semantics, CELLSTYLEMAP source, other graph dependencies or general format support.
implementation: The dedicated selector prepares and sorts the original ten root/child XRECORD handles plus a distinct style XRECORD before changing state, delegates the previous dictionary selection, then publishes the stronger flag and eleven-member set. Existing reader-owned XRECORD tickets bind fixed type 79, frame CRC, location and ordinal; immutable raw/typed snapshots and shared generation/token apply. Joint sealing and every capability query require the dictionary ordered first target to equal the selected XRECORD and its observed H4 owner and reactor to equal the verified dictionary. Existing prior modes retain their exact-set behavior. Old generic set queries require all eleven handles for the stronger mode; the dedicated query accepts the original ten and adds the selected style handle.
